issues.legal_issue: A tenant who obtains and uses conditional protection from eviction by giving an undertaking cannot then challenge the eviction judgment through a special leave petition.
material_facts: A court allowed the tenant to remain in the premises for a limited time on condition that the tenant pay arrears and undertake to deliver vacant possession.
After the tenant's request to obtain more time without giving the undertaking was rejected, the tenant gave the undertaking and thereby obtained protection from eviction.
The undertaking stated that it was subject to the tenant's right to seek special leave to challenge the eviction judgment.
The tenant subsequently filed a special leave petition challenging that judgment.
issues.conclusion: The tenant was precluded from invoking the Supreme Court's jurisdiction under Article 136 to challenge the eviction judgment, and the special leave petition was dismissed. The reservation of a right to seek special leave did not alter the effect of having given the undertaking and availed the protection.
issues.legal_principle: The doctrine of election prevents a party from both approbating and reprobating: a party who accepts an order and obtains an advantage under it cannot then reject that order to obtain another advantage. Applying this principle to the Supreme Court's discretionary jurisdiction under Article 136, the Court relied on Verschures Creameries Ltd. v. Hull and Netherlands Steamship Co. Ltd. (1921) 2 K.B. 608, Thacker Hariram Motiram v. Balkrishan Chatbrabhu Thacker, [1989] Supp. 2 SCC 655, Vidhi Shanker v. Heera Lal, [1987] Supp. SCC 200, and Ramchandra Jai Ram Randive v. Chandanmal Rupchand, [1987] Supp. SCC 254, and referred to Halsbury's Laws of England, 4th ed., vol. 16, para. 1508. A qualification purporting to reserve the right to appeal does not undo the consequences of giving the undertaking and taking its benefit.

rule.if: special_leave_challenge_to_eviction_order and conditional_protection_offered and undertaking_given_to_obtain_protection and protection_from_eviction_availed

predicates.special_leave_challenge_to_eviction_orde: A tenant seeks special leave to challenge an order for eviction.
predicates.conditional_protection_offered: The court offers the tenant continued occupation for a time on condition that the tenant undertakes to deliver vacant possession.
predicates.undertaking_given_to_obtain_protection: The tenant gives the undertaking required to obtain the continued-occupation protection.
predicates.protection_from_eviction_availed: The tenant obtains and uses the protection from eviction on the basis of the undertaking.
predicates.challenge_precluded_by_election: The tenant is precluded from challenging the eviction order after obtaining and using the conditional protection.

issues.definition: When a tenant challenging an eviction order by special leave gives an undertaking to obtain conditional protection and uses that protection, the challenge is precluded by election.
